blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createStep` . It belongs to the Workflows SDK.

This function creates a [StepFunction](/references/workflows/types/workflows.StepFunction) that can be used as a step in a workflow constructed by the [createWorkflow](/references/workflows/createWorkflow) function.

types.name: TInvokeInput
types.description: The type of the expected input parameter to the invocation function.

types.name: TInvokeResultOutput
types.description: The type of the expected output parameter of the invocation function.

types.name: TInvokeResultCompensateInput
types.description: The type of the expected input parameter to the compensation function.

types.name: nameOrConfig
types.description: The name of the step or its configuration.

types.name: invokeFn
types.description:
An invocation function that will be executed when the workflow is executed. The function must return an instance of [StepResponse](/references/workflows/classes/workflows.StepResponse). The constructor of [StepResponse](/references/workflows/classes/workflows.StepResponse)
accepts the output of the step as a first argument, and optionally as a second argument the data to be passed to the compensation function as a parameter.

types.name: compensateFn
types.description:
A compensation function that's executed if an error occurs in the workflow. It's used to roll-back actions when errors occur.
It accepts as a parameter the second argument passed to the constructor of the [StepResponse](/references/workflows/classes/workflows.StepResponse) instance returned by the invocation function. If the
invocation function doesn't pass the second argument to `StepResponse` constructor, the compensation function receives the first argument
passed to the `StepResponse` constructor instead.

types.name: StepFunction
types.description: A step function to be used in a workflow.
